sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Comparative reconstruction of Proto-Mixtec segments and ultimate syllables from 28 modern dialects including San Juan Tamazola (dialect 5); tone is explicitly left out ('omitted the notation of tone in all citations'; PM tone not reconstructed) and the word 'stress' does not occur in the article; the only prosodic remark is the family-wide one that modern disyllabic morphemes carry a level tone on each vowel. Tamazola forms appear untonemarked in the cognate sets (wordlist-type data), so this is primary Tamazola segmental data but no stress or tone statement for the variety.
